title: T1590.006 — Gather Victim Network Information: Network Security Appliances
subtitle: The simulation shows eight scenes of appliance recon.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: The guards
steps.caption: Every network has guards: a firewall, a VPN gateway, a WAF, and a NIDS sensor. Before any attack, an attacker wants to know the brand and version of each one.
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Portal name tags
steps.caption: Special admin URLs act like name tags for vendors. One request to /remote/login returns a login page, and the appliance writes the probe into its web log with the source address.
